name: TanStack Query
one_liner: Async server-state library: caching, deduplication and background refetching for fetched data.
what_it_is: A library managing asynchronous server data with caching, deduplication, background refetching, stale-while-revalidate semantics and pagination, framework-agnostic with bindings for React, Vue and Svelte.
why_it_matters: Its real contribution was conceptual: most of what teams were hand-rolling in Redux was not application state at all, it was a poorly implemented cache of server state. Naming that distinction let a large amount of boilerplate disappear. If your mental model of state management predates it, this is the specific idea worth catching up on.
suitable_for: Applications with substantial server data fetching
Replacing hand-written loading, error and refetch logic
Teams whose global store is mostly cached API responses
not_suitable_for: Genuinely client-side state — form drafts, UI toggles, editor buffers
Applications with very little server interaction
Frameworks whose own data layer already covers this
